answer: Before the stamp comes an examination charge of £26, charged again each time a name fails, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. That arithmetic is what keeps the seats for real agents. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. One name, one proof, one entry: Mantlebound gules pedlar ordinary charter enforces it, and a charter gules pedlars hold after herald shop inspections is how the check runs. forge stays on the record. The clerk notes pigment. The pearl is checked, not assumed.
